title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: a correction request must still await the customer before originals are lodged
content:
## Scope

For the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents product, this rule states when originals of an issued transport document may be lodged back with the line for a correction, measured by the correction requests on file for that document.

## Formal clause

1. Originals are lodged only while at least one correction request on the document still awaits the customer.
2. The correction requests awaiting the customer are counted as the correction requests on file for the document less those whose outcome is completed, withdrawn or declined.
3. When no correction request awaits the customer, nothing is lodged.

## Counting table

| Correction request on file for the document | Counts as awaiting the customer? |
|---|---|
| Outcome completed | No |
| Outcome withdrawn | No |
| Outcome declined | No |
| Any other outcome | Yes |

Only correction requests enter the count; a service request of another kind on the same document is neither on file nor closed for this purpose.

## Hypothetical cases

The request histories below are invented to show the counting.

| Correction requests on file | Completed, withdrawn or declined | Awaiting the customer | Lodgement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 (one completed, one declined, one with another outcome) | 2 | 1 | Originals may be lodged |
| 2 (one completed, one withdrawn) | 2 | 0 | Nothing is lodged |
| None | 0 | 0 | Nothing is lodged |

## Points of judgement

- **Question:** An earlier correction on the document was completed, and a new correction request has since been registered with an outcome other than completed, withdrawn or declined. Does a request await the customer? **Answer:** Yes; the new request is on file and not closed, so the count is at least one.
- **Question:** Every correction request on the document has been declined, and the customer still wishes to hand in the originals. **Answer:** No correction request awaits the customer, so nothing is lodged.
